_comment: PT-1 curated Pattern presets — the 8 dfPatternTemplates (api/static/js/main.js) mirrored as PatternSchema records with source:builtin. Repo-shipped in the COPY'd tree (persistence seam 1): updates land with the code and reach every deployment on image upgrade, never shadowed by the api_data volume. The frozen main.js dfPatternTemplates array is UNTOUCHED — these seeds ARE the oob layer of the Patterns library and feed its list/merge; the Composer Patterns bench still renders from dfPatternTemplates. Each record's steps construct through WorkflowDefinition (the frozen model IS the scaffoldability validator). Generated from dfPatternTemplates — keep in sync (test_pattern_presets.py::test_catalog_matches_statics pins it).

patterns.name: LLM step
patterns.desc: One model call — the atomic unit. Exactly one prompt in, text out.

steps.name: LLM Step
steps.system_prompt: You are a capable assistant. Complete the task described by your inputs and reply with the result.

patterns.name: Orchestrator (dynamic)
patterns.desc: A lead agent plans and spawns workers from a catalog at run time. Ships with one pre-filled worker; worker inputs are always seed.* refs.

planner.role_inline: You are the lead agent. Decompose the goal, spawn workers from the catalog, and integrate their results.
planner.task: Plan the work, dispatch workers, and emit the complete directive once the goal is met.
constraints: Spawn the fewest workers that cover the goal.

worker.name: Worker
worker.system_prompt: You are a focused worker agent. Complete the assigned sub-task and reply with your findings.

patterns.name: Remote agent
patterns.desc: Delegate to an external A2A-protocol agent by agent card + skill. The remote agent owns its own model and prompt.

patterns.name: Consolidate (learn)
patterns.desc: Distill upstream outputs into durable cross-run memory (playbook, semantic, or episodic store).

consolidate.system_prompt: Distill the inputs into concise, durable lessons worth keeping in the playbook.

patterns.name: Code sandbox
patterns.desc: Run Python in the sandboxed executor. Inline source — edit the code in the config panel.

patterns.name: Ralph loop
patterns.desc: Autonomous plan → execute → verify → consolidate loop with a journal and halt rails. Pick a budget preset before dropping — long-running raises the caps for overnight automation.

body.name: Plan
body.system_prompt: You are the planner. Read the goal and the playbook lessons, then emit this iteration's plan as an ordered list of concrete actions.

body.name: Execute
body.system_prompt: You are the executor. Carry out the plan and report exactly what you produced.

body.name: Verify
body.system_prompt: You are the verifier. Check the work against the goal. Emit JSON: {"approved": true|false, "progress": "<one-line status>"}.

consolidate.system_prompt: Record what worked and what failed this iteration as short playbook lessons.

patterns.name: Research fan-out
patterns.desc: Index splits the question into angles, three subagents research in parallel, gather synthesizes one report. Gather's outputs mirror the parent's contract exactly.

steps.name: Index
steps.system_prompt: Break the research question into three distinct, non-overlapping angles. Emit JSON: {"angles": ["<angle 1>", "<angle 2>", "<angle 3>"]}.

branches.name: Researcher 1
branches.system_prompt: You are research subagent 1. Take the first angle from the index and research it thoroughly.

branches.name: Researcher 2
branches.system_prompt: You are research subagent 2. Take the second angle from the index and research it thoroughly.

branches.name: Researcher 3
branches.system_prompt: You are research subagent 3. Take the third angle from the index and research it thoroughly.

gather.name: Gather
gather.system_prompt: Synthesize the three researchers' findings into one coherent report.

patterns.name: TDD loop
patterns.desc: Write → test (sandboxed) → critic, repeated until the critic approves. The critic is the last body step and produces every loop output.

body.name: Write
body.system_prompt: You are the implementer. Write or revise the code to satisfy the requirements and fix any prior test failures.

code.code: print('replace with the test harness for this loop')

body.name: Critic
body.system_prompt: You are the critic. Review the code against the test output. Emit JSON: {"approved": true|false, "code": "<the final code>"}.
